reason: Based on the README, the plugin’s primary user-facing purpose is to add and present an in-UI 2048 mini-game within DeepSeek Harness web sessions, mainly as a floating/navigation panel feature with quick launch controls.

summaries.zh: 该插件在 DeepSeek Harness 的网页界面中加入一个可开启的 2048 小游戏面板，支持方向键或滑动操作，以便用户在会话中进行轻量娱乐。
summaries.en: This plugin adds an in-session 2048 mini-game panel to the DeepSeek Harness web interface, with keyboard and swipe controls for quick casual play.

capabilities: Injects a 2048 game entry into the DeepSeek Harness web UI toolbar.
Displays the game in a floating panel that can be shown, hidden, and closed.
Supports gameplay controls via keyboard keys and swipe interactions.
Offers both persistent bundle-style and dynamic runtime plugin forms for DSH integration.

reasons.code: README states this is a 2048 mini-game for DeepSeek Harness and describes a button in the left side of the input toolbar opening a floating game panel.
README details play behavior, including keyboard (方向键/WASD), swipe controls, draggable yellow title bar, close/hide behavior, and 2048 game state handling.
README lists two plugin forms: a dynamic Cordis plugin and a persistent dsh.bundle-style plugin packaged for installation via `dsh plugin`.
